title: Promises, async/await, and the event loop — concept map
intro: Promise states, chaining, Promise.all/race/any, async/await, microtasks versus macrotasks, AbortController, implementing Promise from scratch, concurrency pools, and comparisons to C# Task.

overviewDiagram.title: Async flow from call to settlement
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TD
  A[Start async work] --> B[Promise pending]
  B --> C{I/O or timer}
  C --> D[Settle fulfilled/rejected]
  D --> E[Microtask queue drain]
  E --> F[await continuation / then]
  F --> G[Next macrotask]

conceptCards.title: Why async JavaScript exists
conceptCards.summary: Single thread must not block on I/O. Callbacks then Promises free the thread during network and disk waits.
conceptCards.example: await fetch(url) — thread serves other microtasks while waiting

conceptCards.title: Promise states and chaining
conceptCards.summary: pending → fulfilled | rejected. then returns new Promise. Return value adoption and throw → reject.

conceptCards.title: Promise.all, race, any, allSettled
conceptCards.summary: all: fail-fast parallel wait. allSettled: partial failure. race: timeout pattern. any: first success.

conceptCards.title: async/await syntax
conceptCards.summary: async fn returns Promise. await pauses until settle. try/catch around await for errors.
conceptCards.example: async function load() { return await fetch(...) }

conceptCards.title: Microtasks vs macrotasks
conceptCards.summary: Drain all microtasks before next macrotask. Promise.then and await are microtasks. setTimeout is macrotask.

conceptCards.title: Implement Promise from scratch
conceptCards.summary: State machine, subscriber list, queueMicrotask for then. Interview staple after LeetCode.

conceptCards.title: AbortController cancellation
conceptCards.summary: Cooperative cancel via signal. fetch + shared signal on shutdown. Analog of CancellationToken.

conceptCards.title: Concurrency-limited pool
conceptCards.summary: Cap in-flight async work. mapPool with N workers. Never Promise.all 10k URLs.

conceptCards.title: Promises vs C# Task
conceptCards.summary: Same await model, different scheduler. Microtasks one thread vs pool threads.
